propositions: RP-05 introduces a unified immutable top-level command registry with lazy handler and parser-factory references as the single source of truth for CLI routing and help generation, replacing repeated command censuses and ad-hoc parsing.

The design mandates side-effect-free stdlib argparse factories for both runtime parsing and deterministic committed help generation, making generated help a public compatibility boundary with no separate docs-only grammar.

Pre-operation help, alias, and unknown-command routing occurs before RP-04 snapshot/config/mount/handler composition, with a taxonomy of canonical, exact, compatibility, hidden, and retired alias rules.
Semantic capability enforcement distinguishes four postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) keyed to packaging extras, evaluated only after the selected mode and backend are known.

ADR 0100 was allocated after ADR 0099 became unavailable, with the approved slug 'cli-command-and-capability-registry' preserved, and generated artifacts (index, marker, number bijection) verified by automated oracles.

Maintainer approval of the exact ADR draft (approved design plus parser/help same-source refinement) was captured on 2026-08-18; no implementation child starts until Gerrit gates pass and the ADR lands.
